column1: # Person-page slugs in the vendored defect register that are reviewed and
# permitted. tests/test_vendored_register_pii.sh REDs on any slug absent here,
# so forgetting a row costs something and cannot pass quietly.
# A slug belongs here ONLY if it is provably not a real person. "I think it is
# fine" is not a reason. If you cannot write why it is fictional, remove it from
# the register in OS003 instead and re-sync.
